text.arabic_uthmani: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱبْتَغُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ ٱلْوَسِيلَةَ وَجَٰهِدُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِهِۦ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ

words.gloss_range: direct vocative call that opens a formal address frame and resets the discourse into command
words.prose: The first word is not a loose exclamation; {{ar:يَا}} ({{tr:yā}}) opens a direct-address frame before any imperative appears. It resets the scene from the prior legal boundary into a formal communal summons, and its widened onset lets the command sequence arrive as addressed speech rather than narration. The call also enters the recognized faith-address formula through the following intermediary rather than addressing the relative clause directly.

topics.headline: formal direct-address frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins by converting the audience into direct addressees before any command is issued.
topics.reason: The vocative particle opens the address clause and the boundary rows show a register shift into second-person command.

topics.headline: recognized mediated address formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the summons belongs to a formal communal address pattern, not an improvised call.
topics.reason: The call-plus-intermediary formula is locally present and functions as the recognized command-address opening.

topics.headline: audible widened onset
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first sound launches the unit with a broad audible entry before the heavier address narrows.
topics.reason: The surface form and sound rows support a recitational onset payoff without changing the grammar.

words.gloss_range: vocative intermediary that stages and formalizes the addressee before the relative clause identifies it

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: definite plural relative identifying the addressed class

words.prose: {{ar:أَيُّهَا}} ({{tr:ayyuhā}}) is the formal buffer between the call and the class being addressed. It first opens an attention slot and then lets {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) fill that slot, so the believers are summoned in stages rather than named abruptly. Its fused shape also gives the buffer attention force, and the liaison with the opening call makes the two-word address sound continuous.

topics.headline: formal vocative intermediary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the address is routed through a formal intermediary before the commanded group is named.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence makes the word the mediated vocative element between the call particle and the relative clause.

topics.headline: open slot narrowed by relative clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the addressee being selected and narrowed step by step instead of appearing as an immediate label.
topics.reason: The following relative clause resolves the open vocative slot created by the intermediary.

topics.headline: attention force in form and liaison
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the fused address form sounds and functions like an attention device.
topics.reason: The formal surface and liaison rows support a modest sound-form payoff.

words.gloss_range: definite plural relative pronoun that turns the following belief verb into the identity criterion for the addressed group
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) turns the opening from a general summons into a defined communal address. The following verb, {{ar:ءَامَنُوا۟}} ({{tr:āmanū}}), becomes the criterion for the group, so belief-status is established before the imperatives begin. The plural relative form also prepares the matching plural verb agreement, keeping the belief clause bound to the addressed class.

topics.headline: relative pronoun defines the addressees
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the commanded group is grammatically defined by a prior action, not left as an undefined audience.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun introduces the defining clause and is appositive to the vocative intermediary.

topics.headline: plural agreement binds the clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the plural form prepares the following verb agreement and keeps the belief clause attached to the addressed class.
topics.reason: The QAC row identifies the plural relative and the following verb supplies matching plural agreement.

topics.headline: identity built before command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the first beat constructing identity before the three-command sequence starts.
topics.reason: The rows describe the recognized communal address formula and the delayed narrowing sequence.

words.gloss_range: completed communal belief/trust that defines the addressees before the commands begin
words.root_gloss_range: root range around safety, security, trust, entrustment, and belief; here Form IV selects active entry into trust-belief while security pressure remains live

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: relative pronoun defining the addressed class

words.prose: {{ar:ءَامَنُوا۟}} ({{tr:āmanū}}) completes the address by marking the audience as those who have already entered belief-trust. Its perfect plural form makes that identity prior to the command, while the root field of safety, trust, and entrustment makes the later move into {{ar:ٱتَّقُوا۟}} ({{tr:ittaqū}}) feel like action flowing from an already formed trust relation. Because the word closes the recurring faith-address formula, the prior legal exception opens into communal obligation, and the long plural ending carries the same audience forward into the plural commands.

topics.headline: completed belief defines the addressees
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the commands are addressed to an already defined believing community, not used to create that identity from scratch.
topics.reason: The perfect plural verb is inside the relative clause and precedes the second-person imperatives.

topics.headline: belief carries trust and safety pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that belief is colored by trust, security, and entrusted reliability, preparing the next command to guard.
topics.reason: The root evidence supports safety and trust pressure while the local verb still names belief/trust as the class marker.

topics.headline: active entry into trust
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices active entry into a trust-state, while the local perfect relative clause keeps it as the completed qualifier of the audience.
topics.reason: Form IV pressure is valid, but it should not replace the local function of the verb as the completed belief qualifier.

topics.headline: formulaic address expands the scene
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the local command scene as part of a wider believing-address pattern that expands the prior legal exception into communal obligation.
topics.reason: The formula and same-surah rows connect the word to recurrent address and local boundary movement.

topics.headline: plural cadence carries audience forward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the sound continuity between the identity marker and the following plural commands.
topics.reason: The sound row adds a small but distinct payoff about the plural cadence at the end of the opening beat.

words.gloss_range: second-person plural imperative of guarded reverent self-protection before God, launching the command triad
words.root_gloss_range: root range around guarding, shielding, protection, preservation, and caution; local Form VIII makes the protection reflexive and relational

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: divine proper name as direct object

words.prose: {{ar:ٱتَّقُوا۟}} ({{tr:ittaqū}}) is the first imperative and it takes {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:allāha}}) directly, so the command begins with a concrete relational stance before God. The root image is shielding and preservation, and Form VIII turns that into self-involving guardedness; locally this is reverent protective orientation, not a free-floating emotion. As the first command, it sets the defensive baseline before seeking and striving are added. The familiar guarding-before-God formula is expanded by the two following imperatives and is grounded by the mercy close of the prior ayah (5:34); the compressed doubled onset makes the first command feel compact and guarded.

topics.headline: first imperative with direct divine object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that guardedness is the first enacted response and that its object is grammatically immediate.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence makes the divine name the direct object, and the verb is the first coordinated imperative.

topics.headline: shielding becomes reverent self-guarding
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the concrete shielding image under the command, while the divine object keeps the sense relational and reverent rather than mechanically defensive.
topics.reason: The root supports guarding and shielding pressure; local grammar and divine object narrow it to reverent self-protective stance before God.

topics.headline: self-involving protection
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the commanded believers participate in their own protection rather than receiving protection passively.
topics.reason: The Form VIII imperative licenses reflexive or middle self-involvement in the guarding act.

topics.headline: defensive pole of ordered triad
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the command sequence beginning with guarded self-regulation before moving to pursuit and exertion.
topics.reason: The local clause chain gives three imperatives in order, with this one opening the progression.

topics.headline: known formula expanded after mercy boundary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a familiar guarding-before-God formula intensified by the expanded triad and grounded by the prior mercy boundary.
topics.reason: The formula, local Surah pattern, sound, and boundary rows add provenance without changing the local parse.

words.gloss_range: the definite divine proper name as direct object of guarding and antecedent for the later directional and possessive pronouns
words.root_gloss_range: divine-name field involving worship, deity, refuge, awe, and disputed derivational pressures; here the proper name fixes one referent rather than a generic deity

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: toward Him as endpoint of seeking

words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:allāha}}) is the direct object of the first command and then becomes the referent carried by the later pronouns in {{ar:إِلَيْهِ}} ({{tr:ilayhi}}) and {{ar:سَبِيلِهِۦ}} ({{tr:sabīlihī}}). The proper-name shape fixes one named divine referent, while the root and derivational evidence adds worship, awe, refuge, and exaltation pressure without turning the word into a generic title. Within Surah 5's legal-command setting, the name carries the prior mercy characterization from 5:34 into the new commands, and the recitational link binds the first command tightly to its object.

topics.headline: one divine referent through three relations
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same divine referent shifting from object, to destination, to path-owner across the ayah.
topics.reason: Attachment and referent evidence support the divine name as object and antecedent for later suffixes.

topics.headline: proper name blocks generic deity reading
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command is anchored in the definite divine proper name rather than an indefinite deity category.
topics.reason: The proper noun form and definiteness evidence fix the referent locally.

topics.headline: worship, refuge, awe, and height pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices worship, refuge, awe, and exaltation pressure around the name, while the local surface remains the proper divine name.
topics.reason: The derivational dispute is valid as pressure but does not replace the local proper-name reference.

topics.headline: legal anchor carried from prior mercy close
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the divine name anchoring the legal-command field and carrying the prior mercy characterization into the new commands.
topics.reason: The rows connect this occurrence to Surah 5 legal discourse, formulaic success contexts, and the boundary from 5:34.

topics.headline: sound binds command to object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the recitational binding of the command to its divine object.
topics.reason: The sound row adds a local audible payoff.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction that adds the second imperative as an equal step while moving the command chain forward
words.prose: This {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) makes {{ar:ٱبْتَغُوٓا۟}} ({{tr:ibtāghū}}) an equal coordinated command after {{ar:ٱتَّقُوا۟}} ({{tr:ittaqū}}). It also marks the first hinge in the chain, so seeking is neither the object of guarding nor a subordinate explanation; it is the second distinct beat. The short connector resets the rhythm before the longer imperative, letting the second command arrive as its own audible step.

topics.headline: second imperative coordinated equally
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second command has equal grammatical force and is not absorbed into the first.
topics.reason: The conjunction links the second imperative to the first as a coordinated clause.

topics.headline: first hinge into command chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices equal coordination working together with forward sequence, turning one command into a triad.
topics.reason: The clitic and repeated conjunction rows support chain structure and balanced triadic framing.

topics.headline: short reset before longer imperative
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the small rhythmic reset before the second imperative arrives.
topics.reason: The sound row contributes a distinct cadence payoff.

words.gloss_range: second-person plural imperative of invested seeking, aimed toward God and taking the means as its object
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes seeking, desire, pursuit, and overstepping; local direction toward God and the means object select disciplined pursuit, not transgression

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: toward Him as goal of seeking

words.prose: {{ar:ٱبْتَغُوٓا۟}} ({{tr:ibtāghū}}) is a commanded pursuit with two controls: {{ar:إِلَيْهِ}} ({{tr:ilayhi}}) gives the destination, and {{ar:ٱلْوَسِيلَةَ}} ({{tr:al-wasīlata}}) names the object sought. The root can lean toward desire and overreach, but the local direction toward God and the definite means channel that energy into disciplined seeking. Its Form VIII shape makes the pursuit personally invested, not a casual wish. Its place between guarding and striving makes it the bridge-command of the triad, and the rare same seeking-means pattern in 17:57 shows that this is a constrained Quranic pairing rather than a generic verb-object phrase.

topics.headline: seeking has destination and object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command separates the divine endpoint from the means being sought.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence gives the verb both the directional complement and the direct object.

topics.headline: desire and overreach channeled toward God
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the root energy of desire and possible excess being disciplined by direction toward God.
topics.reason: The root polarity survives as contrast, while local grammar selects lawful directed seeking rather than transgression.

topics.headline: Form VIII invested pursuit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command is personal and invested, not a casual wish.
topics.reason: The Form VIII imperative and plural suffix support invested communal pursuit.

topics.headline: rare means-seeking pattern with 17:57
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that seeking the means is a constrained Quranic pattern, especially through the 17:57 parallel.
topics.reason: The rows explicitly connect the verb-object-direction pattern to 17:57 without letting that parallel control the local parse.

topics.headline: middle command bridges the triad
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the middle command as a transition from guarded posture into full exertion, with sound and boundary rows reinforcing that movement.
topics.reason: The coordinated position, local Surah contrast, sound pattern, and boundary row all support the bridge payoff.

words.gloss_range: preposition-plus-pronoun phrase marking God as the endpoint toward whom the seeking is directed

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: divine proper name as pronoun antecedent

words.prose: {{ar:إِلَيْهِ}} ({{tr:ilayhi}}) gives seeking its endpoint before the means is named. The suffix points back to {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:allāha}}), and the preposition keeps God as destination while the means remains the object sought. Later {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) shifts the spatial logic from approach toward Him to exertion within His path. The repeated suffix binds the endpoint of seeking to the owner of the path, so the two spatial nodes stay attached to one divine referent.

topics.headline: toward Him as endpoint of seeking
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the destination is named first by pronoun, preventing the means from becoming the goal.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence governs the suffix with the seeking verb and resolves it to the divine name.

topics.headline: towardness contrasts with containment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices two spatial logics: seeking moves toward Him, while striving happens within His path.
topics.reason: The local prepositions distribute endpoint logic and arena logic across the two commands.

topics.headline: same suffix binds destination and path-owner
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the repeated pronoun tying the endpoint of seeking to the owner of the path.
topics.reason: The repeated suffix creates both referential and audible continuity.

words.gloss_range: the definite sought means of approach, a connector or access category directed toward God without being the destination itself
words.root_gloss_range: root range around connecting, reaching, approaching, nearness, means, and station; local syntax selects the sought approach-means while preserving proximity pressure
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْوَسِيلَةَ}} ({{tr:al-wasīlata}}) is the definite object sought by {{ar:ٱبْتَغُوٓا۟}} ({{tr:ibtāghū}}), while {{ar:إِلَيْهِ}} ({{tr:ilayhi}}) keeps God as the endpoint. The word names a connector or means of approach: something pursued as an object but functioning as access, nearness, or linkage. Its singular definite form packages that connector as a focused concept rather than a list of methods. Its rare pairing with seeking, especially the 17:57 parallel, gives the middle command concentrated lexical weight, while the repentance mechanism in 5:34 is generalized here into a communal pursuit of approach before the ayah moves to {{ar:سَبِيلِهِۦ}} ({{tr:sabīlihī}}).

topics.headline: definite sought means, not destination
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the means is a definite object to be sought while God remains the directional endpoint.
topics.reason: The local syntax separates direct object from prepositional destination and the article marks definiteness.

topics.headline: connection and proximity pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the means as a proximity-making connector, while local grammar does not identify one exclusive token, person, act, or technology-like sense.
topics.reason: The root and lexical evidence supports connection, nearness, station, and instrument pressure, narrowed by the definite object construction.

topics.headline: singular noun packages the connector
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the connector packaged as a singular focused concept rather than a list of methods.
topics.reason: The abstract noun and singular definite form support the focused concept payoff.

topics.headline: near-hapax collocation with 17:57
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this word is lexically concentrated and clarified by the only supplied parallel scene at 17:57.
topics.reason: The rows explicitly identify rarity and the 17:57 means-seeking parallel.

topics.headline: middle term between approach and path
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the middle object as the approach mechanism that bridges prior repentance logic and the final path language.
topics.reason: The structural, same-surah, path-pairing, sound, and boundary rows converge on the middle-term payoff.

words.gloss_range: second coordinating conjunction that adds the final imperative and completes the three-command structure
words.prose: The second {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) completes the chain by adding {{ar:جَٰهِدُوا۟}} ({{tr:jāhidū}}) as another coordinated imperative. It prevents the final command from being just an explanation of seeking and makes striving arrive as the climactic third beat. Together with the earlier connector, the repeated short beat gives the triad a measured command cadence.

topics.headline: final imperative coordinated equally
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that striving has its own command force and is not absorbed into the means phrase.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the final imperative with the previous command rather than subordinating it.

topics.headline: second hinge completes triad
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the connector as both addition and culmination, completing the guard-seek-strive architecture.
topics.reason: The second clitic conjunction and repeated wa pattern make the triad visible.

topics.headline: repeated short connector creates cadence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the measured command rhythm created by the repeated short connector.
topics.reason: The sound row adds a distinct cadence payoff.

words.gloss_range: second-person plural imperative of strenuous exertion, objectless but bounded inside God's path
words.root_gloss_range: root range around effort, hardship, utmost capacity, and strenuous engagement; local Form III gives resistant relational exertion rather than a mild attempt

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: within His path as the domain of striving

words.prose: {{ar:جَٰهِدُوا۟}} ({{tr:jāhidū}}) is the third imperative and it does not name a direct object; instead, {{ar:فِى سَبِيلِهِۦ}} ({{tr:fī sabīlihī}}) supplies the domain. The root field makes the command strenuous, capacity-consuming exertion, and Form III adds resistant engagement, while the path phrase keeps that broad struggle bounded inside a divinely owned arena. The command is added to guarding and seeking rather than replacing them, and the nearby striving-in-path description at 5:54 realizes the same profile after this command has redirected communal capacity into path-bound exertion.

topics.headline: objectless striving bounded by path-domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the struggle is broadened by object omission but bounded by the path phrase.
topics.reason: The verb lacks an explicit object and is followed by the prepositional path-domain.

topics.headline: utmost effort and hardship pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command demands exertion at the edge of capacity, not mild effort.
topics.reason: The root evidence supports exertion, hardship, and capacity pressure in the local imperative.

topics.headline: relational resistant engagement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices striving as engagement with resistance, while the local path phrase supplies its domain.
topics.reason: The Form III pattern licenses relational or resistant engagement without requiring an explicit object here.

topics.headline: climactic third command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices striving as cumulative, not a replacement for guarding and seeking.
topics.reason: The second conjunction and matched plural command suffix place this verb at the climax of the triad.

topics.headline: path formula and local realization
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices this command as a marked path-striving directive with nearby realization at 5:54 and boundary redirection from legal capacity into exertion.
topics.reason: The distribution, 5:54 echo, formulaic field, sound, and boundary rows support the provenance of the local command.

words.gloss_range: locative preposition that makes the path the containing arena of striving rather than the destination or instrument
words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) is small but decisive: it turns {{ar:سَبِيلِهِۦ}} ({{tr:sabīlihī}}) into the arena in which striving happens. This differs from {{ar:إِلَيْهِ}} ({{tr:ilayhi}}), where seeking moves toward Him; here exertion is placed inside His path. The brief preposition also opens the heavier final path phrase, giving the last command-complement a compact entry.

topics.headline: path as containing arena
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final command is located within a field rather than aimed at a destination.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the path phrase and supplies the locative domain for the striving verb.

topics.headline: toward Him versus within His path
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah using two different spatial modes for the middle and final commands.
topics.reason: The local contrast between the two prepositions is explicit in the rows.

topics.headline: light entry into final path phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the brief preposition opening the heavier final phrase.
topics.reason: The sound row adds a small cadence payoff.

words.gloss_range: singular possessed path or course that defines the arena of striving as His, not a self-selected route
words.root_gloss_range: root range around path, road, course, way, and channel or flowing passage; local singular possession selects one divinely owned arena
words.prose: {{ar:سَبِيلِهِۦ}} ({{tr:sabīlihī}}) gives the final command its landing: striving occurs within His path, not in any self-chosen arena. The suffix ties the path back to the same divine referent, and the singular possessed form concentrates the image into one owned course, in contrast with plural pathway language in 5:16. The root keeps path, course, and channel imagery alive, so the final arena feels traversable and controlled before the purpose clause opens. It also joins the broader path formula, echoes the earlier means language, and repeats the same suffix heard in the endpoint phrase, carrying the divine referent from the mercy close (5:34) into the final command.

topics.headline: His path as governed arena
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the arena of striving is possessed by God and grammatically governed by the preposition.
topics.reason: The suffix resolves to the divine name and the noun is governed by the preceding preposition.

topics.headline: path and flowing channel pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the path as a traversable course or conduit, while local syntax keeps it as the arena of striving rather than an independent rainfall image.
topics.reason: The root-family channel and flowing pressure survives as imagery, narrowed by the local possessed path phrase.

topics.headline: one owned path, not many routes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the singular possessed form concentrating the command on one divinely owned path, in contrast with plural pathway language such as 5:16.
topics.reason: The rows explicitly contrast singular local form with plural pathway occurrences in Surah 5.

topics.headline: path formula, means pairing, and pronoun echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final path phrase joining a broader path formula while echoing the earlier means and pronoun language.
topics.reason: The collocation, formula, means-pairing, and repeated suffix rows all support the local echo payoff.

topics.headline: final command-complement before purpose
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the command triad closing on a defined divine path before the outcome clause begins.
topics.reason: The phrase completes the final imperative and carries the boundary referent into the path-domain.

words.gloss_range: expectation-purpose particle with second-person plural pronoun, turning the command chain toward a hoped-for result for the same addressees
words.prose: {{ar:لَعَلَّكُمْ}} ({{tr:laʿallakum}}) turns the three imperatives toward an outcome instead of adding a fourth command. The attached pronoun installs the same addressees inside the hope-purpose clause, and the particle keeps success aimed for and contingent rather than automatic. It is the threshold into a recognized success-closing formula, and the doubled consonantal pressure gives that turn toward outcome a firm acoustic landing.

topics.headline: particle governs the success clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same commanded group re-entering the grammar as the subject of the hoped-for outcome.
topics.reason: The particle governs the pronoun as its ism and the following verb as its predicate.

topics.headline: hope and purpose without automatic guarantee
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command chain aims toward success while leaving the outcome contingent, not mechanically guaranteed.
topics.reason: Hope and purpose are locally selected; the wider fear or uncertainty edge is kept as contingency rather than turned into a claim of divine ignorance.

topics.headline: threshold from commands to result
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the structural pivot from three commands into a recognized success-closing formula.
topics.reason: The rows place the particle at the threshold before the final success verb and connect it with formulaic closures.

topics.headline: compressed sound before outcome
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the firm acoustic landing as the ayah turns into the outcome clause.
topics.reason: The sound row adds a distinct local cadence payoff.

words.gloss_range: imperfect second-person plural success verb, naming a prospective communal breakthrough under the hope-purpose frame
words.root_gloss_range: root range around splitting or tilling ground, prospering, succeeding, and attaining success; local Form IV imperfect frames success as cultivated, prospective attainment
words.prose: {{ar:تُفْلِحُونَ}} ({{tr:tufliḥūna}}) is the final word and the predicate of the hope-purpose frame. Its imperfect plural form keeps success prospective, communal, and ongoing, while the root image of splitting or tilling makes success feel like cultivated breakthrough after guarding, seeking, and striving. The formulaic close gathers all three commands under one open success horizon, sharpened by the same guarding-success closure at 5:100, and its sustained final ending completes the shift from a particular legal boundary into communal success.

topics.headline: prospective predicate of the hope clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices success as a prospective communal process under the particle, not a completed fact or fixed label.
topics.reason: The verb is the predicate of the expectation clause, agrees with the addressees, and is imperfect plural.

topics.headline: cultivated breakthrough success
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices success as breakthrough through resistance and cultivation, not passive good fortune.
topics.reason: The root evidence supports cleaving, tilling, prosperity, and success pressure, narrowed by the local abstract success verb.

topics.headline: caused attainment through commanded action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the form presenting the addressees as coming into or bringing about success through the prior commands.
topics.reason: The Form IV morphology supports caused or attained success in the local outcome clause.

topics.headline: one success horizon for three commands
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final formula gathering guarding, seeking, and striving into one hoped-for success horizon, with the 5:100 echo sharpening the closure.
topics.reason: The rows identify final-word position, shared purpose clause, formulaic success endings, co-occurrences, and the Surah 5 echo at 5:100.

topics.headline: rounded communal closure

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The imperative chain from ءَامَنُوا through ٱتَّقُوا, ٱبْتَغُوا إِلَيْهِ ٱلْوَسِيلَةَ, جَاهِدُوا فِي سَبِيلِهِ, and تُفْلِحُونَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Settled trust initiates self-protection; protected desire deliberately seeks a means toward God; effort then spends capacity along His traversable way; flourishing names the hoped-for arrival. The repeated directional markers إِلَيْهِ and فِي سَبِيلِهِ keep every action oriented rather than self-grounded.

activation_trace.role: Heart-settling security supplies the stable point from which the commanded movement begins.
Putting oneself within protection makes taqwa the governing posture of the whole route.
Worship and the worshipped one identify the endpoint and owner of the way.
Deliberate seeking turns the means from a static possession into an pursued relation.
Expenditure of capacity under difficulty supplies the route's costly motion.
A traversable extended road gives the exertion a defined course and means of arrival.
Winning, survival, and attained good provide the prospective result without making it automatic.

changed_reading.before: The ayah is a list of separate pious commands followed by a promise of success.
changed_reading.after: The ayah is one directed approach sequence: inward security becomes guarded desire, guarded desire seeks access, access is enacted through costly travel in God's way, and flourishing remains the hoped-for arrival.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The proximity of ٱتَّقُوا, ٱبْتَغُوا, and جَاهِدُوا فِي سَبِيلِهِ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The same root that supplies seeking can also image transgression, while exertion can mean driving another to the limit. Taqwa and the possessive 'His way' therefore function as internal governors: intensity is legitimate only while protected from crossing limits or consuming another's capacity.

activation_trace.role: A protective barrier supplies the ethical check placed before seeking and exertion.
The branch's limit-crossing aggression exposes the danger latent in undirected seeking.
Bringing a person or thing to the edge of hardship marks the possible excess within exertion.
The specified road confines energy to a course rather than treating sheer force as self-validating.

changed_reading.before: Greater intensity in seeking and striving is necessarily better.
changed_reading.after: The ayah commands disciplined exertion: protection and God's defined way bound desire so that striving does not mutate into transgression or imposed exhaustion.

baseline_models.mechanism: Exertion can image exposed hard ground, a way can image a forward outlet, and falah can image splitting open a constriction before it names winning. Together they make the means an enabling passage through resistance: effort does not merely occur on a prefinished road but helps make an obstructed route passable.

activation_trace.role: Hard exposed land materializes the resistance through which the command moves.
A forward lip or outlet makes the path an aperture through resistance.
Splitting and opening from a narrow place supplies the mechanical shape of breakthrough.
The winning branch converts the made opening into durable arrival rather than a momentary breach.

changed_reading.before: Falah is a generic reward reached after generic effort.
changed_reading.after: Falah is breakthrough: strenuous passage works resistant ground until a God-oriented outlet opens and can be inhabited as enduring good.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier offering scene joins nearness and offering to repeated acceptance, then states that acceptance is from the protected. This revises wasila from an object that secures access into an approach whose reception depends on the seeker's guarded condition.

activation_trace.role: Active seeking anchors the revised model in the focus command to pursue the means.
Self-placement in protection anchors the condition that precedes the means.
Near-drawing and offering to God supply a concrete approach that can be tested rather than presumed effective.
Repeated acceptance with satisfaction makes reception, not mere presentation, decisive.
The protected persons are named as those from whom acceptance occurs, linking approach to guarded character.

structural_cues: 5:27 repeats acceptance three times and closes by restricting it to the muttaqin before 5:35 again places taqwa before seeking the means.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies offering, acceptance, and taqwa; I infer that their sequence regulates the focus's means of approach. A live alternative is that 5:27 only narrates one failed ritual approach and does not define wasila generally.

changed_reading.before: Wasila may be a technique or presented thing that itself guarantees nearness.
changed_reading.after: Wasila is an integrity-bearing approach: the seeker cannot purchase reception by presenting a means while bypassing the protected condition from which God accepts.

context_deltas.mechanism: The packet first mirrors extending and withholding a hand to kill, then scales killing or preserving one life to all people, and finally names hostile, purposeful motion in the earth as corruption. These contrasts make direction and effect, not kinetic intensity, the diagnostic of striving in God's way.

activation_trace.role: Costly expenditure is the focus action whose moral direction the context tests.
The specified traversable road anchors the claim that effort is judged by its course.
The extended hand and refused counter-extension stage bodily capacity under restraint.
Taking life identifies the concrete outcome from which the hand is withheld.
Preserving life and leaving killing undone supplies the positive social measure of directed action.
Departure from sound order names the destructive alternative to life-preserving action.
War and enmity provide an explicit hostile mode that cannot be equated with every difficult exertion.
Purposeful motion toward an object shows that energetic movement can serve corruption when its object is corrupt.
Corruption supplies the named result that differentiates anti-path motion from striving in God's path.

structural_cues: 5:28 mirrors hand extension and non-extension; 5:32 balances killing and giving life; 5:33 couples purposeful movement with corruption immediately before the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies restraint, life-preservation, and a negative model of energetic corrupting motion; I infer that they bound the focus's jihad by direction and consequence. The punitive legal response in 5:33 remains a live alternative pressure, so this is a directional boundary rather than a claim of absolute nonviolence.

changed_reading.before: Jihad can be identified by the amount of force or hardship expended.
changed_reading.after: Jihad in His way is effort morally diagnosed by its God-given route and life-ordering effect; forceful motion toward corruption is its contextual counterimage, not a more intense instance of it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding exception opens a return before others gain power, then seals it with protective forgiveness and mercy. Seeking a means can therefore include a timely route of return for one already implicated in destructive motion, not only forward advancement by an already secure subject.

activation_trace.role: Purposeful seeking anchors repentance as a possible active form of pursuing access.
The available summons-to-repent branch makes the exception an opened call to reverse course.
Precedence and coming-before supply the exception's decisive temporal threshold.
Power that enables action marks the external capture point before which voluntary return remains open.
Covering the fault and protecting its bearer from its effect supplies the route's restorative shelter.
Merciful tenderness prevents the return route from being reduced to tactical escape.

structural_cues: The repentance-before-power exception is the final sentence before the focus address and is followed by forgiveness and mercy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a temporal exception and restorative divine attributes; I infer that this is one contextual shape of the means sought in 5:35. A live alternative confines 5:34 to the legal status of the preceding offenders.

changed_reading.before: The means is for believers who are already moving cleanly forward.
changed_reading.after: The means also names an available return trajectory: before coercion closes voluntary agency, reversal, covering, and mercy can reorient even a damaged path toward God.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately after the focus, total earthly wealth doubled cannot serve as an accepted substitute, and the desired exit is no longer traversable. This makes the means neither stored capital nor a late ransom: it is a path enacted while seeking, protection, and exertion remain possible.

activation_trace.role: Active pursuit anchors the means in present conduct rather than retained exchange value.
A road that must be traversed supplies the focus alternative to substitution.
Putting one thing in place of another supplies the rejected transactional model of access.
Refused acceptance shows that even maximal substitute value cannot compel reception.
Passage to the outside is desired and denied, turning the focus road into a time-sensitive opening.

structural_cues: 5:36-37 directly follow لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ with an unaccepted ransom and a twice-stated failed exit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed substitution and failed exit; I infer that they contrast with the focus's present-tense enacted route. A live alternative is that these verses only describe eschatological impossibility without classifying wasila.

changed_reading.before: Wasila might be a valuable resource saved for securing a favorable outcome.
changed_reading.after: Wasila is nontransferable passage-work performed now; no accumulated equivalent can later replace guarded seeking and travel in the path.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later address exposes a claim of belief that remains at the mouth and has not entered the heart. The focus address to 'those who believed' is therefore a starting claim tested by the ensuing sequence: only heart-settling trust can generate protective, directed, costly movement.

activation_trace.role: Heart-calming assent anchors the focus address as an inwardly realized state.
The repeated belief root is explicitly asserted and negated across two bodily locations, testing the focus label.
Opening the mouth in speech supplies the external claim that cannot carry the route by itself.
The heart supplies the denied site of belief and the later site needing purification.

structural_cues: 5:41 states 'we believed with their mouths' and immediately negates belief in their hearts using the same root as the focus address.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the mouth-heart contrast; I infer that the commands after the focus address function as enactment tests of belief. The alternative is that 5:41 concerns a distinct hypocritical group without revising 5:35's addressee.

changed_reading.before: The opening address certifies a completed identity, after which additional duties are listed.
changed_reading.after: The opening address names a claim that must become cardiac and kinetic: taqwa, seeking, and effort reveal whether spoken belief has actually settled into the heart.

context_deltas.mechanism: Guidance arrives by following preserved traces, yet the packet also assigns a water-access/course and a clear road to each community, calls this differentiation a test, redirects competition toward goods, and gathers all return to God. 'His way' thus names a common vector and evaluative destination without requiring every historically assigned route to have identical form.

activation_trace.role: The focus's extended traversable road anchors the question of unity and differentiation.
Following an earlier trace gives guidance a sequential, inherited mode of travel.
A remaining sign makes prior passage legible to a later traveler.
Gentle indication toward road and truth names the orienting function carried through the traces.
A manifest water-access point supplies a distinct allotted entry to sustaining guidance.
A clear disclosed road supplies the explicit course paired with each allotted access.
Testing that reveals condition makes differentiated routes an arena of disclosure rather than proof of self-sufficiency.
Advancing in a race transfers competition from possession of the route to enacted movement.
Inclination toward useful good fixes the race's object and moral measure.
Return to the prior source supplies the single endpoint that gathers differentiated travel.

structural_cues: 5:46 follows traces carrying guidance; 5:48 places distinct shir'a and minhaj beside testing, racing in goods, and a collective return to God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies traced succession, differentiated courses, a shared ethical race, and one return; I infer that these distinguish common vector from identical route-form. A live alternative restricts the differentiation to legal dispensations and leaves the focus's singular path institutionally uniform.

changed_reading.before: His singular way implies one undifferentiated historical route, and success means possessing its label.
changed_reading.after: His way is a Godward vector recognizable through preserved traces, tested route-specific obedience, and a race in useful good; unity lies in orientation and return, not mere sameness of route-form.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same seeking root later takes 'judgment of jahiliyya' as its object and is opposed to settled certainty about God's judgment. Seeking is therefore morally plastic: the object and direction train desire either into a means toward God or into a return to ungrounded judgment.

activation_trace.role: Purposeful pursuit anchors the focus's command to direct desire toward God.
The repeated pursuit branch carries the same seeking energy toward a contrary object.
Limit-crossing desire exposes how pursuit becomes aggression when its object departs from truth.
The jahiliyya order supplies the regressive object that deforms seeking.
Stable knowledge with doubt removed supplies the settled counter-posture to misdirected desire.

structural_cues: 5:35 and 5:50 repeat the ب غ ي root with sharply opposed objects: a means toward God and judgment of jahiliyya.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated root and opposed objects; I infer that object and direction morally form the act of seeking. A live alternative treats the repetition as ordinary vocabulary rather than a deliberate callback.

changed_reading.before: Seeking is intrinsically devout because it is energetic and sincere.
changed_reading.after: Seeking must itself be converted: desire becomes wasila only when its object and direction are Godward; the same energy can pursue a regressive order and cross the limit.

context_deltas.mechanism: Disordered hearts rush because they fear a hostile turn of the cycle, while the counter-event is an opening from God. The opening branches resonate with falah's splitting branch: flourishing becomes release from fear-driven circular calculation into a widened God-given passage.

activation_trace.role: Splitting open from constriction anchors the focus outcome as breakthrough rather than generic advantage.
Weakening and impaired motion diagnose why the heart cannot hold a straight course.
Circulation of conditions supplies the feared political loop that drives opportunistic haste.
An obstruction opening into a widened entrance supplies the straight counterimage to fearful circulation.
Opening into victory ties the spatial release to the reversal the fearful calculators try to control.

structural_cues: 5:52 moves from heart-sickness and fear of a da'ira to the possibility of a divine fath, then to exposure and regret.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies circulation and opening; I supply the cross-root arrow from fath's opening to falah's splitting. A live alternative reads fath strictly as a future judgment or victory event with no semantic effect on falah.

changed_reading.before: Falah means gaining the favorable side of changing fortunes.
changed_reading.after: Falah is release from the cycle of fear-based positioning: the protected seeker holds a straight Godward course until an obstruction opens, rather than orbiting every anticipated reversal.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's exertion root reappears as the utmost intensity of oaths, yet those speakers' works collapse. Juhd therefore cannot be validated by maximal verbal force, solemnity, or self-presentation; it must become aligned action that survives the test of the path.

activation_trace.role: Expenditure of capacity under hardship anchors the focus's enacted demand.
A formally distributed oath supplies the solemn speech-act whose intensity proves insufficient.
The exact exertion branch intensifies the oaths and exposes intensity without faithful trajectory.
The oath branch locates the exertion in declaration rather than durable deed.
Collapse and falling away give the verbal maximum a failed outcome.
Purposeful work supplies the embodiment that is judged void despite emphatic oaths.

structural_cues: 5:53 places جَهْدَ inside emphatic oaths and immediately follows it with the collapse of works.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact root repetition and the oath/work reversal; I infer that it audits what counts as valid exertion in 5:35. A live alternative treats جَهْدَ أَيْمَانِهِمْ as an idiom with no callback to جَاهِدُوا.

changed_reading.before: Jihad is authenticated by how absolute, strenuous, or loudly pledged it appears.
changed_reading.after: Jihad is embodied fidelity along the path: maximal oath-intensity can coexist with collapsed work, so exertion is authenticated by durable direction rather than verbal force.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact focus phrase 'they strive in the way of God' returns inside a social and affective profile: mutual love with God, gentleness without humiliation toward believers, strength toward rejecters, freedom from fear of blame, and reception of divine bounty. These relations specify the human texture of the exertion.

activation_trace.role: Costly exertion anchors the focus command that the later profile embodies.
The God-owned traversable road anchors the phrase repeated in the profile.
Love abiding in the heart makes exertion responsive to mutual attachment rather than self-generated aggression.
Gentleness without abasement supplies the inward-facing manner of the striving community.
Strength after lowliness supplies firmness without canceling the paired gentleness.
The repeated exertion root directly carries the focus command into this relational profile.
The repeated road root confirms that the profile inhabits the same God-owned course.
Expected harm from social censure is present but no longer governs the path.
Blame for alleged fault supplies the social pressure from which directed exertion remains independent.
Gift and beneficence frame the entire capacity to strive as received bounty rather than earned superiority.

structural_cues: 5:54 repeats يُجَاهِدُونَ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ nearly verbatim and embeds it between mutual love, paired gentleness/strength, fearlessness before blame, and divine bounty.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one syntactic profile around the repeated phrase; I infer that its neighboring qualities specify the mode of jihad. A live alternative treats them as cumulative virtues of the same people without making each a strict condition of the term.

changed_reading.before: Jihad is an abstract or primarily adversarial expenditure of force.
changed_reading.after: Jihad is love-originated relational stamina: gentle without abasement, firm without ego, unruled by blame, and understood as gifted capacity while traveling God's way.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing movement defines near, supportive allegiance through God, the messenger, and believing practitioners of prayer, giving, and bowing, then names a gathered party whose outcome is prevailing. The Godward means can therefore be carried communally as enacted loyalty, not possessed privately as an access device.

activation_trace.role: The worshipped endpoint anchors the focus's 'toward Him' and 'His way' in a relation rather than an object.
Love, support, and allegiance supply the social bond through which Godward orientation is practiced.
Specified worship gives allegiance a repeated embodied practice.
Growth and increase make giving a circulation that builds communal life rather than private depletion.
Bowing as humility prevents communal allegiance from becoming self-exalting solidarity.
Nearness without an intervening gap turns allegiance into a relational mode of approach.
A group gathered around a position makes the route corporate rather than merely individual.
Prevailing strength supplies a communal counterpart to the focus's hoped-for falah.

structural_cues: 5:55-56 repeat allegiance and belief, move through prayer, giving, and bowing, and close the packet with a gathered God-aligned party that prevails.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies relational nearness, concrete communal practices, and collective prevailing; I infer that these can embody the focus's means of approach. A live alternative reads the closing verses only as defining valid allegiance, not as unpacking wasila.

changed_reading.before: The means is an individual technique for securing private proximity and success.
changed_reading.after: The means can be a lived network of Godward allegiance: worship, redistributive growth, humility, and mutual support carry approach communally, with falah reframed as shared prevailing.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps textual placement onto travel rather than claiming a direct lexical gloss of sabil. It remains anchored in the focus's road and the context's explicit movement of words away from assigned places. Downstream prose should mark it as a hermeneutic-spatial analogy, not identify every interpretive disagreement as path-corruption.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: فِي سَبِيلِهِ as a course that can be kept or left.

activation_trace.role: A traversable extended road supplies the focus anchor for faithful orientation.
Deflection away from a direction gives distortion the shape of leaving a course.
Meaningful speech connecting speakers supplies the material whose orientation is manipulated.
A thing's assigned settled place supplies the position from which speech is displaced.

changed_reading.before: The Godward means concerns conduct on an external road, while handling words is a separate issue.
changed_reading.after: Keeping meaningful words oriented in their assigned places may itself be pathkeeping; displaced speech can engineer a counterfeit means by bending the verbal road.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it combines hard land, rain, grain, a water-source, an opened outlet, and plowing into one material analogy. It remains focus-anchored through jihad, sabil, and falah and context-anchored through explicit branch inventories. Downstream prose must present it as an exploratory ecological model, never as the translation or exclusive referent of wasila.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: جَاهِدُوا فِي سَبِيلِهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ, with the uncited surface وَسِيلَة naming the enabling relation.

activation_trace.role: Hard exposed land supplies the resistant field in which exertion occurs.
Rain suspended between cloud and earth supplies a descending life-channel.
The extended grain-ear supplies the route's cultivated yield.
The farmer who splits earth turns falah into sustained cultivation rather than instant reward.
Earth revived by rain connects life-preservation to the material yield of a watered route.
A manifest water-access point gives the means the shape of reaching a sustaining source.
Water bursting from its outlet supplies the enabling release that irrigates the hard field.

changed_reading.before: The path is a road already laid out, and flourishing is a prize at its end.
changed_reading.after: The path can be imagined as an irrigation and cultivation system: access reaches a source, an opening releases life, hard ground is worked, and flourishing grows as grain rather than arriving as a detached prize.

strongest_changes: The means became an accepted and enacted approach conditioned by taqwa, not a self-validating offering, stored asset, or late ransom.
Jihad became directionally and relationally bounded: life-ordering course, heart-rooted love, gentleness and firmness, and durable work matter more than force or oath-intensity.
The singular Godward way became compatible with traced succession and differentiated tested routes whose shared measure is racing in useful good and returning to God.
Repeated ب غ ي showed that desire is morally formed by its object, while the opening imagery made falah a release from fearful circulation rather than favorable positioning within it.
summary.what_was_special: Exact root recurrences across the packet did most of the activating work: belief moved from mouth to heart, seeking split by its object, exertion failed as oath-intensity and returned inside a love-shaped profile, and path language expanded through traces, water-access, clear roads, opening, and communal allegiance.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet provides no branch inventory for the focus root و س ل, so models anchor the surface construction but cannot branch-cite الوسيلة itself.
The punitive material in 5:33 limits how far the life-preserving direction model can be rendered as a general nonviolence claim.
The differentiated routes in 5:48 may concern legal dispensations specifically rather than every dimension of the singular path in 5:35.
The opening, displaced-word, and irrigated-cultivation models are cross-root analogies and should remain explicitly exploratory.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Nearness is made by strained passage.** `و س ل B001` is nearing by a desired means, `ج ه د B001` spending capacity under strain, and `س ب ل B001` an extended traversed way. The sequence supplies destination, means, exertion, and path. I infer that nearness is produced through sustained movement, not possession of a static intermediary.
2. **Success is cultivated by cleaving ground.** `ف ل ح B003` is the tiller splitting earth and `B005` lasting success. I infer that exertion opens resistant terrain so durable good can grow; the agricultural image turns success into cultivation.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later ayah 5:120 made the fixed ayah's local distinctions newly visible as bounded operations within a single encompassing dominion, rather than as an isolated rule or episode.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **The means of approach is enacted under strain.** Fixed **و س ل / B001** (“nearing by a desired means”) supplies relational movement, and fixed **ج ه د / B001** (“spending one’s capacity under strain”) assigns effort as its operating force. 5:34 models an early voluntary return; 5:36 immediately rejects total earthly wealth as a ransom substitute. I infer that the sought means consists in directed, costly action rather than a detachable asset. The ayah reads *wasīlah* as a practiced approach along the path, not an object possessed apart from striving.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 5:36 decisively ruled out the means as a purchasable asset, while 5:39’s repair showed the kind of transformed conduct that can actually accompany return.

baseline.text: Ey inananlar! Allah'a karşı gelmekten sakının, ona yaklaşmanın yolunu arayın ve onun yolunda çaba gösterin ki kurtuluşa eresiniz.

findings.text: Allah'a yaklaştıracak yol, sahip olunan bir nesne değil, güç harcanarak geçilen zorlu ve yönlü bir yaklaşımdır.
Kurtuluş, toprağı yarıp işleyerek ürün alma gibi süreklilik isteyen bir emektir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadeleri bu dali yalniz korkunun kalkmasi olarak degil, kalbin yatismasi, guven verme, guvenilirlik, emanet edilen sey, guvenli yer ve dayanilir nitelik alanlariyla birlikte verir. Bu nedenle dalin cercevesi, guvenlik ve guvenilirlik ekseninde hem yalın hem de yapimli ve baglamli kullanislari ayirt ederek korunabilir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal inanma ya da dua cevabi degil; korkudan emin olma, guven verme ve guvenilir sayilma alanidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalin guven ve korkusuzluk anlamlari ile belirli yapimli ya da soz obegi kullanislari birlikte vardir; tanim bunlari tek bir dar kaliba indirgemez.

concept_map.definition: Korkunun kalkmasiyla kalbin yatismasi, birine guven verilmesi veya bir kimsenin ya da seyin guvenilir kabul edilmesidir. Bu alan guvenli yer, emanet edilen sey, kendisine guvenilen kisi ve dayanilir binek gibi bagimli uygulamalari da kapsar.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek korkuya karsi guven, ic yatiskinligi ve tehlikeden emin olma halidir.
Guven verme, birini kendi koruma ve teminat alani icine alma olarak kullanilir.
Guvenilirlik, ihanete karsi sadakat, emanet edilen sey ve kendisine guvenilen kisi anlamlarini dogurur.
Guvenin bulundugu yer, bir kimsenin emniyet icinde oldugu mesken veya siginak olarak adlandirilir.
Dayanikli ve aksamasindan korkulmayan deve kullanimi, guvenilirlik niteligini canli bir ornege uygular.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ortak olarak bu dali korkunun ziddi olan guven, kalbin yatismasi ve guven verme alaninda toplar. Ayni iddia guvenilir kisi, emanet, guvenli yer ve dayanilir binek gibi turemis ya da baglamli kullanislari da cekirdege baglar.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الأمن ضد الخوف، والأمان وإعطاء الأمنة، والأمانة ضد الخيانة وما اؤتمن عليه، والآمن والمأمن والاستئمان، والأمين والمأمون وما يوثق به، ومنه وثاقة الناقة الأمون.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس تصديق الإيمان من حيث هو تصديق، ولا صيغة آمين في الدعاء، ولا أمن المركبة من أم ومن في قوله أمن هو قانت.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الأمن ضد الخوف (ayn;sihah)؛ أصل الأمن طمأنينة النفس وزوال الخوف (mufradat)؛ الأمانة ضد الخيانة ومعناها سكون القلب (maqayis)؛ الأمان إعطاء الأمنة (maqayis;ayn)؛ أمن فلان يأمن أمنا وأمانا وأمنة فهو آمن (tahdhib)؛ استأمن إليه دخل في أمانه (sihah)؛ مأمنه منزله الذي فيه أمنه (mufradat)؛ الأمون الناقة الأمينة الوثيقة أو التي يؤمن فتورها وعثورها (ayn;sihah;mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadeleri bu dali acikca tasdik, haber ya da vaadi dogru sayma ve bazi dini kullanislarda hakka boyun egme olarak verir. Provisional cerceve guvene dokunan yanini not eder, fakat dal kimligi korkusuzluk degil tasdik ve kabul iliskisidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal guvenlik hali degil; bir soz, haber, vaat veya hakikati dogru kabul etme alanidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Hem genel tasdik adlari hem de belirli soz obekleri ve dini kullanislar vardir; tanim bunlari yalin guven anlamina genisletmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir haber, vaat veya hakikati dogru sayip ona icten kabul ile yonelmektir. Dini kullanista bu kabul, kalp, dil ve davranisla baglanan bir boyun egme ya da seriate girme anlami kazanabilir.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek bir haberin, sozun veya hakikatin dogru sayilmasidir.
Hakka yonelik ic kabul, yalniz bilmekten ziyade boyun egme ve kabullenme bicimi alir.
Dini alanlarda bu kabul, bildirilen yola girme ve ona baglanma adi olarak kullanilir.
Ilahi sifat kullaniminda vaat edilen odulu dogrulama veya guvenceyle bildirme boyutu one cikar.

Kadının saçı ile dış örtüsü arasına koyduğu bez, bu koruyucu ara katmanın özel bir örneğidir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yalnızca toynak ağrısından kaçınmayı değil, hafif topallamayı, topallayan atın davranışını, hayvanda yara açmayan eyeri ve aksayışa göre davranma sözünü birlikte verir. Bu nedenle dal korunabilir, fakat geçici hayvanın kendini koruması çerçevesi bütün malzemeyi taşıyacak biçimde aksama ve ona bağlı kullanımlar olarak yeniden kurulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek hafif topallama ve ağrılı ya da hassas toynak yüzünden sakınarak yürümedir; eyer, emir ve sert zemin kullanımları bağımlı yan kullanımlardır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tek sözcüklü hafif topallama anlamı, atın yürüyüşü ile eyer ve emir kalıplarına bağlı anlamlardan açıkça ayrılır.

concept_map.definition: Hafif topallama ile, özellikle toynak ağrısı veya hassasiyeti yüzünden yürümekten çekinen ya da sert zeminde ayağını sakınan atın durumu. Aynı kullanım kümesi, hayvanın aksamasına göre davranmayı, sert zeminden yakınmamayı ve hayvanda yara açmayan eyeri de anlatır.

facets.statement: Tek sözcüklü temel anlam, hayvanın yürüyüşündeki hafif topallamadır.
At, topalladığı veya toynağındaki ağrı yüzünden yürümekten çekindiği ve sert zeminde ayağını sakındığı için bu nitelemeyi alır.
Hayvana yönelik emir kalıbı, onun aksayışını gözeterek yürümeyi sürdürme ve kendini zorlamama anlamı taşır.
Eyer için kullanıldığında hayvanın sırtını yaralamayan veya berelenmesine yol açmayan eyer anlatılır.
Sert ve engebeli zeminle kurulan olumsuz emir, arazinin güçlüğünden yakınmama anlamına gelir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kaynak ifadesi hafif topallamayı çekirdek yapar ve bunu topallayan, toynak ağrısı yüzünden yürümekten çekinen ya da sert zeminde ayağını sakınan atla açımlar. Aksamaya göre davranma, sert zeminden yakınmama ve yara açmayan eyer kullanımları aynı kümede yer alan fakat çekirdeğe bağımlı yan kullanımlardır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dalı bilinen bir ağırlık ölçüsü olarak doğrular, ancak tek ve değişmez bir nicelik vermez. Bir kullanım kırk gümüş para ağırlığını, başındaki ses düşmüş başka bir biçim ise yağ için yedi temel ağırlık birimini gösterir; tanım bu bağlam farkını açıkça korumalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca bu adlandırılmış ağırlık ölçüsü ve onun biçimleriyle sınırlıdır; genel tartma eylemine, her türlü miktara veya modern bir ölçü adına genişletilmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, iki sözcük biçimine bağlı farklı ölçü değerlerini ve çoğul biçimleri ayırır; bunlardan genel bir kök anlamı çıkarmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir kullanımda kırk gümüş paranın ağırlığına, başındaki ses düşmüş başka bir biçim ve kullanımda ise yağ için yedi temel ağırlık birimine eşit kabul edilen ölçü. İlk biçim daha düzgün sayılır ve birden çok çoğul biçimi vardır.

facets.statement: Temel biçim, belirli bir ağırlık ölçüsüdür ve para hesabında kırk gümüş paranın ağırlığına eşitlenir.
Başındaki ses düşmüş biçim, yağ ölçümünde kullanılan ve yedi temel ağırlık birimine eşit sayılan ayrı bir değeri bildirir.
Başlangıç sesini koruyan biçim daha düzgün kabul edilir ve ölçü adının iki çoğul söylenişi kaydedilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kaynak anlatımı, aynı ölçü ailesinde bağlama ve sözcük biçimine göre iki değer aktarır: para hesabında kırk gümüş para ağırlığı ve yağ hesabında yedi temel ağırlık birimi. Başlangıç sesini taşıyan biçim daha düzgün kabul edilir; ölçü adının iki çoğul biçimi de verilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dalı doğrudan örümcek kuşunun adı olarak verir, adın son sesi bulunan ve düşmüş iki biçimini kaydeder ve adlandırmayı kuşun yürürken adımlarını fazla açmamasına bağlar. Geçici çerçeve bu sınırı doğru biçimde yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca örümcek kuşunun bu iki adına ve adlandırma açıklamasına aittir; koruyan kişi, topallayan at veya yara açmayan eyer anlamlarına geçmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, kuşa verilmiş iki özel ad biçimiyle sınırlı tutulur ve bunlardan genel bir koruma ya da yürüme anlamı türetilmez.

concept_map.definition: Örümcek kuşunun, biri son sesi koruyan diğeri bu sesi düşüren iki biçimde söylenen adı. Adlandırma, kuşun yürürken adımlarını fazla açmamasıyla açıklanır.

facets.statement: Sözcük, örümcek kuşunu adlandıran özel bir kuş adıdır.
Kuş adı, son sesi bulunan daha uzun ve bu sesin düştüğü daha kısa iki biçimde kullanılır.
Adın kuşa verilmesi, yürürken adımlarını fazla açmayan kısa adımlı yürüyüşüyle açıklanır.

root_profile.summary: Kökün merkezinde, zarar ile korunacak taraf arasına koruyucu bir unsur koyma fikri vardır; bu fikir kişinin kendisini korkulan veya yanlış davranıştan sakınmasına ve hayvanın ağrılı adımını gözeten bazı kullanımlara uzanır. Belirli ağırlık ölçüsü ile örümcek kuşu adı ise bu koruma çekirdeğinden ayrışmış adlandırma dallarıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tapınma eylemini, kişinin kendini tapınmaya vermesini, bir varlığı tapınılır kılmayı ve tapınılan varlığı aynı anlam örgüsü içinde açıkça birleştirir. Geçici dal çerçevesi bu çekirdeği ve ondan türeyen varlık adlarını doğru biçimde temsil eder.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, tapınma eylemi ile bundan türeyen tapınılan veya tapınılır kılınan varlık anlamlarını kapsar; şaşkınlık, yoğun üzüntü ve salt özel ad kullanımları bu sınırın dışındadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın eylem çekirdeğini türemiş eylem ve varlık adlarından ayırır; türemiş biçimlerin kapsamı yalın eylemin tamamına aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir varlığa tapınma eylemini ve kişinin kendini tapınmaya vermesini anlatır. Türemiş kullanımlarda bir varlığı tapınılır kılmayı, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınma konusu sayılan varlıkları da adlandırır.

facets.statement: Temel eylem, bir varlığa tapınmak ve kişinin kendini bu tapınmaya vermesidir.
Eylemden türeyen varlık anlamı, kendisine tapınılan varlığı veya tapınma konusu sayılan nesneyi gösterir.
Ettirgen kullanım, bir varlığı başkalarınca tapınılır duruma getirme veya öyle sunma işlemini bildirir.
Güneşe kimi topluluklarca tapınılması nedeniyle ona tapınılan varlık anlamındaki bir ad verilmesi, varlık anlamının tarihsel bir örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, tapınmayı anlamın temeli sayar; kişinin tapınmaya yönelmesini, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınılır kılma işlemini bu temelden türetir. Tapınma konusu sayılan yontular ve güneş örneği, varlık anlamının belirli uygulamalarıdır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أله وتأله بمعنى عبد وتنسك، والتأليه بمعنى التعبيد، والإله والآلهة والإلاهة لما جعل معبودا.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه أله بمعنى تحير، ولا ألهت على فلان بمعنى اشتد جزعي عليه، ولا أسماء المواضع أو الحية أو الهلال إلا من جهة التسمية لا معنى العبادة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: أصل واحد وهو التعبد، فالإله الله تعالى لأنه معبود، وتأله الرجل إذا تعبد، والإلاهة الشمس سميت بذلك لأن قوما كانوا يعبدونها (maqayis)؛ التأله التعبد (ayn)؛ أله بالفتح إلاهة أي عبد عبادة، مألوه أي معبود، الآلهة الأصنام، التأليه التعبيد، التأله التنسك والتعبد (sihah)؛ لا يكون إلاها حتى يكون معبودا، معبوداتهم من الأصنام والأوثان آلهة، الإلاهة الشمس، وإلاهتك وعبادتك (tahdhib)؛ إله اسما لكل معبود، أله فلان يأله الآلهة عبد، فالإله على هذا هو المعبود (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi Yaratıcıya özgü adın kendisini, genel tapınılan-varlık adından türetiliş açıklamasını ve bu özel adla kurulan seslenme ile ant biçimlerini birlikte verir. Geçici çerçeve kullanılabilir, ancak dal yalnızca seslenme ve ant kalıpları değildir; özel adın yalın kullanımı da çekirdekte tutulmalıdır.

facets.statement: Dalın merkezinde, Yaratıcıyı başkalarından ayırarak gösteren ve yalnız ona özgü sayılan özel ad bulunur.
Özel adın, tapınılan varlığı bildiren genel addan ses düşmesi ve belirleyici unsur eklenmesiyle oluştuğu açıklanır.
Özel ad, sözün başında ant değeri taşıyarak ardından gelen yapmama bildirimini güçlendirebilir.
Özel adın doğrudan ya da seslenme öğesi yerine geçen bir sonla kullanılması, yakarma ve dilek bildiren seslenme biçimleri kurar.
Ses veya parçaların düşürüldüğü kısalmış biçimler, şaşma ve ant anlatan kalıplarda kullanılır.

Bu nedenle sunulan dal kimliği kaynak kapsamını doğru temsil eder.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, doğrudan arama ve isteme alanındadır; haksızlık, yara bozulması, cinsel davranış, yağış, at koşusu ve askerî öncülük anlamlarını içermez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın dalı kapsar; başka dallara veya yalnızca belirli söz öbeklerine bağlı anlamlar bu genel arama anlamına aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi, ihtiyacı veya amacı istemek, aramak ve ona yönelmek; kimi kullanımda bunu özel bir çabayla ya da ölçüyü aşan bir istekle yapmaktır. Eylem, bir başkası için aramayı veya onun arayışına yardım ederek onu arayan duruma getirmeyi de kapsayabilir.

facets.statement: Bir şeyi, ihtiyacı veya amacı istemek, aramak ve ona yönelmek.
Arayış, kimi kullanımda özel çaba göstermeyi veya ölçüyü aşacak kadar yoğun istemeyi bildirir.
Bir başkası için bir şeyi aramak ya da o kişinin arayışına yardım ederek onu arayan duruma getirmek.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, dalın temelini bir şeyi isteme ve arama olarak ortaklaşa verir. Aynı toplu kanıt, aranan ihtiyacı veya amacı, çabalı arayışı ve bir başkasının aramasına yardım etme yönünü de kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın haksız sınır aşımını; birine karşı yöneltilen, fail adıyla belirtilen ve karşılıklı gerçekleşen özel kullanımlardan açıkça ayırır.

concept_map.definition: Hak veya ölçü sınırını aşarak haksızlık etmek, başkasına karşı saldırgan biçimde üstünlük taslamak ya da doğru olandan yanlış olana yönelmektir. Eylem tek yönlü olabileceği gibi tarafların birbirine haksızlık etmesi biçiminde de gerçekleşebilir.

facets.statement: Hak veya ölçü sınırını aşarak haksızlık ve baskı uygulamak.
Bir başkasına karşı üstünlük taslayıp saldırgan biçimde haddini aşmak.

Sınır aşımını doğru olandan yanlış olana yönelme veya kibirlenme olarak açıklamak.

Geçim darlığı ile yemini olabildiğince pekiştirme ise bu çekirdeğin belirli yapılardaki kullanımlarıdır; dal yalnızca kişinin kendi isteğiyle çaba göstermesi diye daraltılmamalıdır.

concept_map.definition: İnsanın erişebildiği güç ve yeterlik, zor bir durumun doğurduğu sıkıntı ve bir işte ya da düşünmede bütün gücü kullanarak son sınıra varma alanıdır. Belirli yapılarda dar geçimi ve bir yemini olabilecek en güçlü biçimde pekiştirmeyi de anlatır.

facets.statement: Bir insanın erişebildiği güç, yeterlik ve yapabilme sınırıdır.
Hastalık ya da zor bir iş yüzünden çekilen güçlük ve sıkıntıdır.
Bir işte, düşünmede veya kişinin kendisini zorlamasında bütün gücü kullanıp erişilebilecek son noktaya varmaktır.
Geçimle ilgili yapıda az bir şeyle yaşama ve yaşamın dar, sıkıntılı olması anlatılır.
Yeminle ilgili yapıda kişinin yemini elinden geldiğince güçlü biçimde pekiştirmesi anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak alanı güç yetirebilme, güçlük çekme ve gücün sonuna kadar kullanılmasıdır. Toplu tanıklık ayrıca düşünmede yoğun çabayı, dar geçimi ve yeminin en yüksek güçle pekiştirilmesini belirli kullanımlar olarak gösterir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, düşmana karşı koymak için bütün gücü kullanmayı dalın ortak çekirdeği yapar. Bazı anlatımlar bunu doğrudan savaşma diye dar ifade ederken daha geniş anlatım düşmana karşı koymayı esas alır; verilen dal çerçevesi bu farkı koruyabilecek kadar uygundur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnız bir düşmana yönelen karşı koyma veya savaşma kullanımıdır; genel güç, güçlük ve çaba anlamı tek başına bu dala girmez.

facets.statement: Bir düşmana karşı koyarken eldeki bütün gücü kullanmaktır.

Karşı koyma anlatımı savaşmadan daha geniştir ve dalın birden fazla türe ayrılabilmesine izin verir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dalı ettirici bir yapı üzerine kurar: bir kişi başkasını erişebileceği güç sınırına götürür, hayvanı gücünün üstünde sürer veya düşmanlıkta baskıyı artırır. Verilen dal resmi bu katılımcı değişimini ve zorlamayı doğru yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Zorlayan ile zorlanan ayrıdır; kişinin kendi gücünü isteyerek kullanması bu dalın yeterli tanımı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam yalnız bir kişiyi, hayvanı veya karşı tarafı hedef alan kayıtlı eylem yapılarında geçerlidir; genel ve yalın bir güçlük anlamına genişletilmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişiyi ya da hayvanı gücünün veya dayanmasının sınırına dek zorlamak, gerektiğinde ona yapabileceğinin üstünde yük bindirmektir. Düşmanlık yapısında ise karşı tarafa yönelik baskının aşırı ölçüde artırılmasını anlatır.

facets.statement: Bir başkasını erişebildiği güç ve dayanma sınırına dek zorlamaktır.
Bir hayvanı yolculukta taşıyabileceği gücün üstünde sürüp yormaktır.
Bir topluluğun düşmanlıkta karşı tarafa yönelik baskıyı ve sertliği aşırı ölçüde artırmasıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar birini yapabileceğinin sonuna götürme konusunda birleşir. Hayvanı gücünün üstünde sürme bu ettirici çekirdeğin özel örneği, düşmanlıkta aşırıya gitme ise kişiler arası baskıya uzanan kullanımıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi sert toprağı ortak ve güçlü bir anlam olarak verir, fakat bir tanıklık alanı en düz ve açık yer, boş alan ve bitkisiz kıraç toprak yönlerine genişletir. Bu nedenle dal resmi kullanılabilir, ancak arazinin mutlaka hem sert hem yüksek veya çıkıntılı olduğu söylenemez.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Sertlik temel anlamdır; düzlük, açıklık ve bitkisizlik aynı nesnenin zorunlu özellikleri değil, kaynakta görülen anlam değişkeleridir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalın bir arazi adıdır; tanıklanan sert, düz, açık ve kıraç yer anlamları korunur ve başka dallardaki eylem yapıları buraya taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Sert toprağı veya sert araziyi adlandırır. Kaynak değişkesinde çok düz ve açık yer, boş alan ya da üzerinde hiçbir şey bulunmayan kıraç toprak için de kullanılır.

facets.statement: Sert ve dayanıklı yüzeyi olan toprak veya arazidir.
Çok düz, belirgin ve açıkta kalan araziyi ya da boş alanı anlatabilir.
Üzerinde hiçbir şey bulunmayan bitkisiz ve kıraç toprağı anlatabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların paylaştığı belirgin anlam sert arazidir. Toplu iddia buna en düz ve görünür yer, açık boş alan ve bitkisiz kıraç toprak kullanımlarını ekler; bunlar tek bir zorunlu özellik kümesi olarak birleştirilmemelidir.

concept_gloss.text: sert, açık ya da bitkisiz arazi
concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın ortak sert arazi anlamıyla kaynakta tanıklanan açık ve kıraç arazi değişkelerinin birlikte gösterilmesi gerektiğinde uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Sertliği temel anlam olarak, açıklık ve bitkisizliği ise ayrı değişkeler olarak korur.
